rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for H1/H2 headings. Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond is mandatory for book titles and primary banners.
Uppercase eyebrow tags must strictly use tracking-[0.2em] with JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono.
Max hero header size is text-6xl (clamp ceiling 60px). Do not use text-7xl or text-8xl.

spacing_and_layout.bento_strategy: Asymmetric editorial grids with breathing margins and wide gutters (gap-8 to gap-12)
spacing_and_layout.header_rules: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FBF9F5]/90 border-b border-[#2E241F]/10 py-4. Never make transparent.
spacing_and_layout.footer_rules: Massive high-contrast footer in deep espresso (#181412) with champagne gold rules and archival typographic sign-off.

catalogue_and_assets.strategy_notes: Five books supplied with live download links. First-page canvas preview generator acts as primary fallback with elegant foiled faux-jacket rendering if extracted covers are not provided.

five_books.title: Architectonics of Form
five_books.subtitle: A Monograph on Spatial Tension & Monolithic Brutalism
five_books.author: Lucien Vane & Atelier Monolith
five_books.description: An exhaustive archival study of structural geometry, tectonic stone, and unadorned concrete volumes. Printed with tri-tone lithography on archival 170gsm GardaPat Kiara matte art paper with blind-debossed spine lettering.

five_books.title: Ephemera of Solitude
five_books.subtitle: Letters, Marginalia, and Polaroids from Northern Fjords
five_books.author: Helena Rostova
five_books.format: Thread-Sewn Swiss Binding with Custom Sleeve
five_books.description: A sensory visual diary exploring silent arctic landscapes and hand-inked confessions. Features gold gilded page rims, Japanese Munken Lynx uncoated pages, and archival facsimile postcards tipped in by hand.

five_books.title: Alchemy of Pigment
five_books.subtitle: Mineral Extractions, Madder Lakes & Raw Earth Inks
five_books.author: Dr. Cassian Moreau
five_books.format: Heavy Millboard Quarter-Bound in Raw Ecru Silk
five_books.description: From lapis lazuli grinding in Renaissance Venice to burnt umber recipes in Flemish ateliers. Includes 96 color-match swatches and high-definition microscope photography of crystalline pigment dispersal.

five_books.title: Chronicles of the Vellum Guild
five_books.subtitle: Medieval Scriptoria, Oak Gall Inks, and Illuminated Leaves
five_books.author: Sister Beatrice & Brother Alistair
five_books.format: Debossed Calfskin Leatherette & Double Gold Foil
five_books.description: An intimate revelation into 12th-century monastic scriptoria. Features folding triptych leaf inserts, historical commentary, and full-bleed high resolution scans of gilded historiated initials.

five_books.title: Typographic Poetics
five_books.subtitle: Lead Sorts, Letterpress Pressures, and Concrete Verse
five_books.author: Matthias Kroll
five_books.format: French Fold Softcover with Hand-Tied Cotton Cording
five_books.description: A visceral manifesto celebrating the physical bite of metal type sinking into damp cotton rag. Features specimen inserts printed on Heidelberg cylinder presses with custom pantone formulations.

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, cart toggle, checkout trigger, input, and modal close must have a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

guidelines: Avoid AI Slop: Do not use generic purple/blue gradients or centered bootstrap templates. Use an Ivory, Espresso, and Champagne Gold palette inspired by Assouline, Obys, and Vellum Editions.
High Contrast & Legibility: Always set explicit text colors on hover/focus. Never allow gray-on-gray low contrast text.
Mock Status Transparency: Prominently feature the MOCKED INTEGRATION badges on checkout, payments, and AI concierge to adhere strictly to client instructions.
Use Pre-installed packages: Tailwind v4, react-router-dom, motion, lucide-react, sonner are already installed. Do not reinstall them.
Do not use transparent background on header, dialogs, or dropdowns. Always provide backdrop-blur with minimum 80-90% background opacity.
